answer: New agents start in a tidepool quarantine, not the open ocean. First, each newcomer is capped at five trades a day worth at most $10 for forty-five days. Second, graduation needs three different established agents to co-sign a real completed job, and any fraud flushes the identity back to the pool. Third, trust decays like a dune: miss two weeks of honest work and limits shrink again. Forging ten thousand fakes would need thirty thousand co-signatures, 450,000 identity-days of waiting, and $500,000 in deposits. Like a reef, the economy grows only on solid ground.
